Basic operation

Once the error has been deleted, if the check shows that the error has not reappeared then the test is over.

Disconnect the bag connector on the line involved and activate the relevant line closure resistor.

Delete the error and check that it has disappeared using a testing device such as Examiner.

Reconnect the bag connector.

Check the continuity of the wiring from the control unit comb to the bag connector; there should be no breaks or short circuits.

If there are no faults, the control unit is faulty.
